dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, the university in Chiang Mai called. Either I accept their offer by Friday, or they'll give my place to someone else.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈkɔːld. ˈiːðər aɪ əkˈsɛpt ðɛr ˈɔːfər baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ, ɔːr ðeɪl ˈɡɪv maɪ ˈpleɪs tə ˈsʌmwʌn ˈɛls.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow. Have you heard from the one in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. hæv juː ˈhɜːrd frəm ðə ˈwʌn ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not yet. I won't hear from them until next month. And neither Mom nor Dad wants to decide for me.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. aɪ ˈwoʊnt ˈhɪr frəm ðɛm ənˈtɪl ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ. ənd ˈniːðər ˈmɑːm nɔːr ˈdæd ˈwɑːnts tə dɪˈsaɪd fər miː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So if you wait for Bangkok, it's a gamble.
dialogue.reading: soʊ ɪf juː ˈweɪt fər ˈbæŋkɑːk, ɪts ə ˈɡæmbəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Exactly. If I don't commit to Chiang Mai now, I might not get into either one.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt kəˈmɪt tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ˈnaʊ, aɪ maɪt ˈnɑːt ˈɡɛt ɪntə ˈiːðər ˈwʌn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What does your instinct tell you?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dʌz jʊr ˈɪnstɪŋkt ˈtɛl juː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My instinct says Chiang Mai. But I keep hesitating.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈɪnstɪŋkt ˈsɛz ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ. bʌt aɪ ˈkiːp ˈhɛzɪteɪtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Because it's either the best decision of my life or the worst!
dialogue.reading: bɪˈkɔːz ɪts ˈiːðər ðə ˈbɛst dɪˈsɪʒən əv maɪ ˈlaɪf ɔːr ðə ˈwɜːrst!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's probably neither! You'll be happy in either city.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈprɑːbəbli ˈniːðər! juːl bi ˈhæpi ɪn ˈiːðər ˈsɪti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Maybe. I'll think it over tonight and decide tomorrow.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. aɪl ˈθɪŋk ɪt ˈoʊvər təˈnaɪt ənd dɪˈsaɪd təˈmɑːroʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Either way, I'm proud of you.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈiːðər ˈweɪ, aɪm ˈpraʊd əv juː.
